Multi-Pass Consensus & Self-Consistency Structured Batch Extraction

Source: R/consensus.R
airgap_extract_consensus.Rd

Executes deterministic multi-pass local LLM extraction across multiple random seeds and/or prompt template variants, aggregating strictly typed fields via majority vote (character, enum, logical) or robust central tendency (numeric, integer). Returns a strictly typed consensus tibble with per-row agreement scores, per-field consensus diagnostics, and a long-format pass table (consensus_passes()) directly compatible with multi-facet psychometric reliability auditing (for example generalizability studies).

Usage

airgap_extract_consensus(
  data,
  text_col,
  schema,
  runtime,
  n_passes = 3L,
  seeds = NULL,
  prompt_templates = NULL,
  id_col = NULL,
  numeric_agg = c("median", "trimmed_mean", "mean"),
  trim = 0.1,
  tie_policy = c("first", "na"),
  pii_policy = c("redact", "pseudonymize", "verified_deidentified"),
  pii_config = NULL,
  pii_key = NULL,
  vault = NULL,
  vault_path = NULL,
  encrypt_vault = TRUE,
  reidentify_output = FALSE,
  max_retries = 2L,
  container_spec = NULL,
  model_path = NULL,
  allow_internal_network = FALSE,
  strict_proxy = TRUE,
  output_pii_action = c("redact", "error", "warn", "none"),
  audit_log_path = NULL,
  run_id = NULL,
  progress = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing input text rows.

text_col

Character scalar name of the text column in data.

schema

An extraction_schema() object.

runtime

A local air-gapped runtime created by runtime_ollama(), runtime_openai_local(), or runtime_mock().

n_passes

Integer number of passes when seeds is NULL (default 3L). Must result in at least 2 total passes across seeds and prompts.

seeds

Optional integer vector of explicit decoding seeds. When both seeds and prompt_templates are supplied, executes the full crossed seeds x prompt_templates design.

prompt_templates

Optional character vector (named or unnamed) of prompt templates containing "{text}".

id_col

Optional character scalar column name supplying unique row IDs.

numeric_agg

Aggregation rule for numeric and integer fields: "median" (default), "trimmed_mean", or "mean".

trim

Fraction of observations trimmed from each end when numeric_agg = "trimmed_mean" (must be in [0, 0.5), default 0.1).

tie_policy

Tie-breaking policy for categorical/logical majority vote: "first" (default, selects first winning level in pass order) or "na" (returns typed NA on exact ties).

pii_policy

Pre-inference privacy policy: "redact" (default), "pseudonymize", or "verified_deidentified".

pii_config

Optional pii_config() object.

pii_key

Secret key required when pii_policy = "pseudonymize".

vault

Optional existing airgap_pii_vault.

vault_path

Optional destination path for saving the encrypted vault.

encrypt_vault

Logical scalar; encrypt saved vault file. Defaults to TRUE.

reidentify_output

Logical scalar; re-identify character consensus columns locally when pii_policy = "pseudonymize". Defaults to FALSE.

max_retries

Maximum structured repair retries per row per pass (default 2L).

container_spec

Optional airgap_container_spec().

model_path

Optional local model weight path for pre-flight SHA-256 verification.

allow_internal_network

Logical scalar passed to preflight_isolation_check(). Defaults to FALSE.

strict_proxy

Logical scalar passed to preflight_isolation_check(). Defaults to TRUE.

output_pii_action

Post-inference output PII scan policy: "redact" (default), "error", "warn", or "none".

audit_log_path

Optional path to append a hash-chained consensus run audit entry.

run_id

Optional run identifier.

progress

Logical scalar; emit brief CLI progress messages. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble of class c("airgap_consensus", "tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame") containing the row ID column, strictly typed consensus schema columns, .agreement (row-level mean field agreement in [0, 1]), .passes_ok, .passes_total, and .status. Retrieve the long-format pass table, per-field diagnostics, and provenance metadata via consensus_passes(), consensus_diagnostics(), and attr(res, "airgap_manifest").

Examples

data("synthetic_notes", package = "airgapllm")
sc <- extraction_schema(
  sentiment = schema_field("enum", values = c("positive", "neutral", "negative")),
  severity = schema_field("integer", min = 0L, max = 10L),
  crisis = schema_field("logical")
)
res <- airgap_extract_consensus(
  synthetic_notes[1:4, ],
  text_col = "note_text",
  schema = sc,
  runtime = runtime_mock(seed = 10L),
  n_passes = 3L,
  id_col = "note_id"
)
res
#> # A tibble: 4 × 8
#>   note_id sentiment severity crisis .agreement .passes_ok .passes_total .status
#>   <chr>   <chr>        <int> <lgl>       <dbl>      <int>         <int> <chr>  
#> 1 SYN_001 positive         6 TRUE        0.689          3             3 ok     
#> 2 SYN_002 negative         7 FALSE       0.489          3             3 ok     
#> 3 SYN_003 positive         9 FALSE       0.6            3             3 ok     
#> 4 SYN_004 negative         6 FALSE       0.6            3             3 ok     
consensus_diagnostics(res)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   field     type    n_valid_rows mean_agreement pct_unanimous n_ties
#>   <chr>     <chr>          <int>          <dbl>         <dbl>  <int>
#> 1 sentiment enum               4          0.583            25      2
#> 2 severity  integer            4          0.533             0      0
#> 3 crisis    logical            4          0.667             0      0
head(consensus_passes(res))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 9
#>   unit_id pass_id prompt_id  seed sentiment severity crisis .status .attempts
#>   <chr>   <chr>   <chr>     <int> <chr>        <int> <lgl>  <chr>       <int>
#> 1 SYN_001 pass_01 P1           10 positive         9 TRUE   ok              1
#> 2 SYN_002 pass_01 P1           10 negative         8 FALSE  ok              1
#> 3 SYN_003 pass_01 P1           10 positive         7 FALSE  ok              1
#> 4 SYN_004 pass_01 P1           10 positive         6 FALSE  ok              1
#> 5 SYN_001 pass_02 P1           11 positive         0 TRUE   ok              1
#> 6 SYN_002 pass_02 P1           11 neutral          0 FALSE  ok              1
